messages:
ridhi: thinking about a keyboard-first quick-action palette in Run Inspector. hit '.' or 'K' on a selected run to open actions: open schema, copy sample, export-TS/export-Py, pin-as-sample, rerun-with-params.
ana: nice. keyboard-first is great for power-users. how do we handle context (which function/schema) when multiple tools are in one run?
sam: show grouped actions per tool and use arrow keys to switch tools. label each action with the tool name: "(toolName) Open schema".
matt: perf note: don't generate TS/Python types until user explicitly selects export to avoid blocking palette open. show a spinner next to export option.
julie: accessibility: palette must be fully keyboard operable, have role=dialog, aria-modal=false so SRs know it's a transient control. add aria-describedby that explains escape will close.
ridhi: focus management: trap focus inside while open, restore to run entry on close, and announce with polite live region: "Quick actions opened for run X".
ana: UX question: should pinned samples live in a separate 'Samples' tab or inline pinned badge on run?
sam: both? pin adds a persistent badge and adds to Samples library. hitting 'S' in the palette could open samples management.
matt: copy text tweak: label "Export TypeScript" -> "Export as TypeScript type (open in new tab)" and similar for Python.
julie: test plan: keyboard-only walkthrough, screenreader pass, and timing export operations under slow network.
ridhi: telemetry events: palette.open, palette.action_select, palette.export_start, palette.export_complete. Anonymize run ids.
playground-bot: Feature branch: feature/quick-actions-palette deployed to staging: https://playground-staging.redwood.ai/?feature=quick-actions. Reactions: :eyes:3 :thumbsup:4
